maria: Quick pre-launch check for midnight change window. Short answers only. Who owns signalboard?
release-bot: Deploy scheduled 00:00 UTC. Canary: 5% -> 25%. Pin prod to v4.1.0.
simon: I'll own signalboard and post every 5m.
alice: On-call. I'll be rollback lead. Rollback triggers: error-rate >1.5% sustained 10m OR p50 latency 2x baseline.
paul: Observability & smoke. I'll run quick synthetics post-canary.
maria: Escape hatch: manual unpin by release lead + oncall. If rollback causes data issues, cut hotfix.
simon: Canary 5% running, tagging @alice on any FAIL.
release-bot: Canary metrics: error 0.3%, p50 +7%.
paul: Smoke suite passing, kv hit 98%. No new exception groups.
alice: Watching. If conditions met, I'll execute rollback-playbook and notify SRE.
maria: Final thumbs?
simon: +1
paul: +1
alice: +1
release-bot: Canary promoted to 25%. Keep messages status-first (OK/WARN/FAIL).
maria: Thanks team. Quiet rollforward scheduled at +40m if we stay green.
